messages.subject: D-RUG today 1-3 in Wickson 2124
parts:
Hi all,

A reminder that the first D-RUG work session of the quarter will be today 1-3PM in Wickson 2124.  Kara Moore O'Leary will be be presenting on the popbio package and how she uses it in her work on rare plant demographics.

Also, R version 3.0.0 was released this week.  Bring your questions about upgrading and new features (or e-mail the list with them if you can't make it).  If there are enough, we may compile a FAQ / upgrade guide.

Noam


On Tue, Apr 2, 2013 at 9:48 AM, Noam Ross <noam...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi all,

This week at D-RUG Kara Moore O'Leary will be talking about the popbio package which constructs and analyzes projection matrix models. Kara will present examples from her own work projecting the demographics of a rare native CA perennial plant along with some of her own tweaks.

If you took Marissa and Sebastians's course last quarter, the popbio package has tools to automate and streamline a lot of the methods they taught.

D-RUG this quarter will be held Thursdays 1-3PM in Wickson 2124.

Noam
